mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast06_tr (ast06_tr_id, ast06_company_id, ast06_person_id, ast06_date, ast06_tr_cd, ast06_corp_id, ast06_ast_class_tree_id, ast06_cont_amt, ast06_tax, ast06_amt, ast06_settle_mng_yn, ast06_deposit_id, ast06_note, ast06_cur_cd, ast06_pur_tr_id, ast06_book_amt, ast06_for_amt, ast06_for_cont_amt, ast06_fx_rate, ast06_fee) VALUES (#{trId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{r.date}, #{r.trCode}, #{r.corpId}, #{r.astClassTreeId}, #{r.contAmt}, #{r.tax}, #{r.amt}, #{r.settleMngYn}, #{r.depositId}, #{r.note}, COALESCE(#{r.curCode}, 'KRW'), #{r.purTrId}, #{r.bookAmt}, COALESCE(CAST(#{r.forAmt} AS numeric), #{r.amt}), COALESCE(CAST(#{r.forAmt} AS numeric), #{r.contAmt}), COALESCE(CAST(#{r.fxRate} AS numeric), 1), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE ast06_tr SET ast06_date = #{r.date}, ast06_tr_cd = #{r.trCode}, ast06_corp_id = #{r.corpId}, ast06_ast_class_tree_id = #{r.astClassTreeId}, ast06_cont_amt = #{r.contAmt}, ast06_tax = #{r.tax}, ast06_amt = #{r.amt}, ast06_settle_mng_yn = #{r.settleMngYn}, ast06_deposit_id = #{r.depositId}, ast06_note = #{r.note}, ast06_cur_cd = COALESCE(#{r.curCode}, 'KRW'), ast06_pur_tr_id = #{r.purTrId}, ast06_book_amt = #{r.bookAmt}, ast06_for_amt = COALESCE(CAST(#{r.forAmt} AS numeric), #{r.amt}), ast06_for_cont_amt = COALESCE(CAST(#{r.forAmt} AS numeric), #{r.contAmt}), ast06_fx_rate = COALESCE(CAST(#{r.fxRate} AS numeric), ast06_fx_rate) WHERE ast06_tr_id = #{r.trId} AND ast06_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT ast07_settle_id AS settle_id, ast07_tr_id AS tr_id, ast07_settle_date AS settle_date, ast07_settle_amt AS settle_amt, ast07_amt AS amt, ast07_deposit_id AS deposit_id, ast01_class_tree_nm AS deposit_name, ast07_note AS note, ast07_tr_cd AS tr_code, act02_journal_id AS journal_id, ast07_for_settle_amt AS for_settle_amt, ast07_fx_rate AS fx_rate, ast07_for_amt AS for_amt FROM ast07_settle LEFT OUTER JOIN ast06_tr ON ast06_tr_id = ast07_tr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN pay50_expense ON pay50_expense_id = ast07_expense_id LEFT OUTER JOIN act02_journal ON act02_tr_id = ast07_settle_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ast01_class_tree_id = ast07_deposit_id WHERE ast07_tr_id = #{trId} OR ast07_expense_id = #{trId} ORDER BY ast07_settle_date

SELECT ast01_class_tree_id AS ast_class_tree_id, ast04_settle_date AS date, ast03_tr_cd AS tr_code, ast04_settle_amt AS amt, ast04_tax AS tax, ast03_cf_nm AS note, ast03_corp_id AS corp_id, COALESCE(ast01_cur_cd,'KRW') AS cur_code, ast04_cont_amt AS cont_amt, ast03_cf_info_id AS org_tr_id FROM ast01_class_tree INNER JOIN ast03_cf_info ON ast03_ast_class_tree_id = ast01_class_tree_id INNER JOIN ast04_cf ON ast04_cf_info_id = ast03_cf_info_id INNER JOIN ast15_tr_code_window ON ( ast15_company_id = ast01_company_id AND ast15_tr_cd = ast03_tr_cd AND ast15_window_class_nm = #{windowClassName} ) WHERE ast01_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast01_asset_type = #{assetType} AND ast04_settle_date = #{stdDate} AND COALESCE(ast03_icam_yn,'false') = 'false' AND ( ( #{personId} IN ( SELECT ast10_person_id FROM ast10_manager WHERE ast10_manager_type = '1' AND ast10_link_id = ast01_class_tree_id ) ) OR ( #{orgId} IN ( SELECT ast10_org_id FROM ast10_manager WHERE ast10_manager_type = '2' AND ast10_link_id = ast01_class_tree_id ) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ast06_tr WHERE ast06_company_id = ast01_company_id AND ast06_tr_cd = ast03_tr_cd AND ast06_ast_class_tree_id = ast03_ast_class_tree_id AND ast06_corp_id = ast03_corp_id AND ast06_date = ast04_settle_date AND ast06_org_tr_id = ast03_cf_info_id )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast06_tr (ast06_tr_id, ast06_company_id, ast06_person_id, ast06_ast_class_tree_id, ast06_date, ast06_tr_cd, ast06_amt, ast06_for_amt, ast06_cont_amt, ast06_for_cont_amt, ast06_settle_mng_yn, ast06_note, ast06_corp_id, ast06_tax, ast06_cur_cd, ast06_fx_rate, ast06_fee, ast06_org_tr_id) VALUES (#{trId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{r.astClassTreeId}, #{r.date}, #{r.trCode}, #{r.amt}, #{r.amt}, #{r.contAmt}, #{r.contAmt}, 'true', #{r.note}, #{r.corpId}, #{r.tax}, #{r.curCode}, 1, 0, #{r.orgTrId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ast13_pur_tr_id AS pur_tr_id, ast13_ast_class_tree_id AS ast_class_tree_id, CASE WHEN substr(ast01_item_s_class_cd,1,2) = '55' THEN f_cdnm('ItemMClassCode', ast01_item_m_class_cd, ast13_company_id, ast13_pur_date) ELSE f_cdnm('ItemSClassCode', ast01_item_s_class_cd, ast13_company_id, ast13_pur_date) END AS item_type, ast01_class_tree_nm AS item_name, f_ast_class_tree_nm_allpath2(ast13_ast_class_tree_id) AS item_full_name, ast13_pur_date AS pur_date, ast13_pur_amt AS pur_amt, ast13_depn_date AS depn_date, ast13_depn_cost AS depn_cost FROM ast13_book_depn INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ast01_class_tree_id = ast13_ast_class_tree_id WHERE ast13_company_id = #{companyId} AND (ast13_pur_tr_id, ast13_depn_date) IN ( SELECT ast13_pur_tr_id, MAX(ast13_depn_date) FROM ast13_book_depn WHERE ast13_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast13_depn_date <= #{depnDate} GROUP BY ast13_pur_tr_id ) AND COALESCE(ast13_retire_date,'9999-12-31') > #{depnDate} ) t WHERE CONCAT(item_type, item_name) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY item_type, pur_date
